# prompt-pivot

> Store, version, edit and publish LLM prompts at runtime from inside a FastAPI app, using the app's own PostgreSQL or MySQL database. Python library: PyPI `prompt-pivot`, import `promptpivot`.

Start with the agent guide: it states the rules that are easy to get wrong (async vs sync forms, labels not versions, template brace rules, fragments, approvals).

## Docs

- [Agent and developer guide](src/promptpivot/agent-guide.md): how to use the library correctly; also `prompt-pivot docs`
- [README](README.md): install, quickstart, concepts, settings, security, production checklist, rollback runbook
- [Feature guide](docs/guide.md): every feature with code, UI and CLI usage, use cases, UI walkthrough, when-to-use decisions, troubleshooting
- [API reference](docs/reference.md): generated from the code, every public class and method
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Optional

- [Example app](examples/app.py): runnable FastAPI demo with SQLite
